reason: My salon runs on regulars, Google reviews and the WhatsApp group, and that keeps my chairs full. I've never used creators and I don't see why I'd start just because the app is free.
objection: I already get creators asking for freebies every week; a platform that shows them my business straight away just means more of those requests, and I doubt a few coupon redemptions would justify a free haircut or facial.
would_change_my_mind: Another salon owner I know in my area telling me it actually brought them paying customers who came back, with the numbers to show it.
